Hand in hand to success
Headteacher's Welcome
Welcome to Barn Croft Primary School!
We are a small (but mighty) one-form entry primary school in Waltham Forest, where children are at the heart of everything we do. The moment I first visited Barn Croft, I was struck by the warmth, enthusiasm, and dedication of the pupils, staff, and wider community. It was clear that this is a school where children thrive—not just academically but as curious, creative, and confident individuals. I am incredibly excited for the journey ahead as we continue to build on the school’s strengths and embrace the bright future before us.
Barn Croft is a truly inclusive school, where every child is valued and supported to reach their full potential, regardless of their starting points or needs. We believe in developing the whole child—fostering a love of learning while also nurturing creativity, independence, and a sense of responsibility. Our children are artists, thinkers, leaders, and changemakers. We empower them to have a voice, to take on leadership roles, and to shape their school experience through initiatives such as the school council, peer mentoring, and playground friends. We pride ourselves on being a school of the community, for the community, with everyone—staff, parents, and children—working together to make Barn Croft the best it can be.
Our setting is unique, with an incredible site that gives the school a village feel. With space dedicated to art, gardening, and our much-loved outdoor learning, our children benefit from hands-on experiences that enrich their learning beyond the classroom. From exciting trips to a curriculum designed to inspire, we ensure every child has the broadest possible experiences to prepare them for the world ahead. We want our children to leave Barn Croft with smiles on their faces, a belief that they can achieve anything, and the foundations for a bright and successful future.
This is a school on the rise, full of energy and ambition, and I am thrilled to be leading it into its next chapter. I warmly invite you to visit us and experience the magic of Barn Croft for yourself!
Adrien Schweitzer - Headteacher
Our school motto is “Hand in Hand to Success” and everyone here believes that only by working together will we secure the best possible future for our children. Everything we do comes back to our values of COURAGE, LOVE, EXCELLENCE – the courage to stand up for what we believe and to challenge ourselves even when we find things hard or difficult; that love is being compassionate and nurturing towards each other and caring for everyone and the world around us; that through an attitude of striving for excellence in all we do we can reach for the stars and achieve our dreams!
We truly believe in inclusion at Barn Croft and really do go the extra mile to ensure that EVERY child, no matter what their needs or background, is given everything they need to succeed and to have a joyful experience of primary school.

pageCache.text:
Our School
Barn Croft Primary is one of the few remaining single form entry primary schools left in the borough of Waltham Forest and we pride ourselves on knowing all our children as individuals. Our personalised approach extends throughout a child’s school career from the initial home visit in Early Years when staff take the time to get to know the parent and child through to ensuring that our Year 6 pupils are fully prepared for the transition to secondary school.
We are a friendly and inclusive school where children settle in quickly and make good progress. We work hard to ensure that we meet all the needs of all our children both academic, social, emotional and any particular special needs. We believe that at the heart of this success lie excellent relationships built on trust and respect – between the teachers and the pupils and between all the staff and the parents & carers. We are all learners and as such we acknowledge that we might not always get things right first time. However, we believe that by having good communication and open discussion with parents & carers we can ensure the very best primary school experience for the children.
The Headteacher and Deputy Headteacher are available for discussing any issues or concerns and can be found most mornings in the playgrounds before school. We have a weekly newsletter which is sent electronically to parents & carers and is uploaded every Friday to the website, we hold termly Parent & Teacher Meetings to discuss the children’s progress and we conduct an annual Parent Survey so that we know what parents think of us and how we could improve. Good communication is a two way process, and we will also be in touch quickly with any parents where, for example, attendance is poor, behaviour or learning causes concern, a child is frequently late or comes to school without the correct uniform.
Barn Croft Primary is a good school which is continually striving to be better and provide the very best educational experiences for the children. We are also seen to be the hub of this wonderful community by the families we serve and this makes us very proud. Our hope is to develop our children into the future young people who will go out into the world carrying our values of COURAGE LOVE EXCELLENCE and prepared to make a difference and live happy, healthy lives.

Breakfast Club and Tea Time Club
Breakfast Club
At our Breakfast Club the children can have a healthy breakfast with cereals, yogurt and/or toast plus various toppings including scrambled eggs and baked beans. As well as the nutritional benefits, children also have an opportunity to socialise and play with their friends. There is a reading corner, lots of games and the ever popular table football. Once the playground starts to fill up the Breakfast Club staff and children head out for a quick run around before lessons begin and the youngest children are escorted to class.
For many children, this gradual start to the day helps them to settle in better. Overall it’s a very popular start to the day!
To support families best we offer two options for Breakfast Club.
Breakfast Club Prices
7:30am – 8:00am Arrival
8:00am – onwards Arrival
*Places at Breakfast Club can be pre booked, but drop ins are also welcome.

Tea Time Club
We provide after school care for children in Reception to Year 6.
Our Tea Time Club is run by staff who are qualified, experienced, enthusiastic and DBS cleared. We provide a friendly, welcoming and fun atmosphere with a varied activity programme with lots of choice in a safe and secure environment. They have access to outdoor play, a quiet area for reading and relaxation, as well as opportunities to socialise with other children.
Children are provided with a healthy snack in line with the school food trust standards.
After school club is open from the end of the school day until 6pm. The cost per day is £12.50 and should be pre booked with a minimum of two days notice.
How to Book a place:
If you are interested or have any questions, please contact the school office on 020 8521 1145 or email us at: School@barncroft.waltham.sch.uk
You can also download a copy of our registration form from our website. Alternatively, please pick up a registration form from our school office.

pageCache.text:
Peer Mentors
As part of our commitment to supporting social and emotional development at school, eight Year 6 children have recently completed a three-week training programme to become Peer Mentors.
These children were carefully selected based on their potential to be positive role models and their interest in working with younger pupils. The programme gives them the opportunity to develop their confidence, leadership, and communication skills.
Each Peer Mentor is paired with one or more mentees—often younger children who may find social situations challenging, need support making friends, or benefit from guidance during playtimes.
Mentors and mentees meet once a week for a structured activity, but mentors are also encouraged to check in informally, such as during playtimes. They act as a buddy, someone to talk to, and a source of encouragement.
Teach their mentees new games
Help them build friendships
Support positive social interactions
Be a friendly face in the playground
"I really like meeting up with my mentee—we get to talk a lot about things we like to do."
— Year 6 Peer Mentor
“It’s fun to help kids, it makes me happy to be with my mentee”
— Year 6 Peer Mentor
"My mentor comes to see me at playtime to see if I am alright."
This programme is already making a positive impact, helping children feel more included, confident, and supported in their daily school life
